description: Prune comments after nontrivial code edits and before handoff, or when asked to decomment, remove, clean up, or trim comments in a file, working tree, branch, diff, PR, or commit range. Subtractive only: delete narration and restatement, trim doc comments to caller contracts, preserve directives. Route factual drift to code-gardening and refactoring to code-simplifier. Skip prose, docs, and pre-existing comments outside the named scope.
